title: Carrera GO!!!

scope.basis: Initial documented selection of road pieces and track-mounted accessories.
scope.availability: Historical and current products are mixed; catalogue inclusion does not imply current availability.

defaults.note: Car scale is descriptive. Physical dimensions are millimetres. Centred slot offsets are a nominal model, not manufacturing tolerances.

visualStyle.basis: Original schematic SVG interpretations of the cited product/catalogue illustrations; connector details are illustrative.

sources.title: Carrera Zandvoort Park Circuit: manufacturer parts and lengths
Carrera 2013 international catalogue
sources.note: Manufacturer catalogue archived by Carrera Club; GO special pieces, product photos and 61658 mixed-length retail pack.

sources.title: Joe’s Carrera GO!!!: original technical measurements
sources.note: Independent measurements: 114 mm road width, 60 mm slot spacing, R1/R2 diameters. Slot offsets are centred nominally.

sourceIssues.detail: Lengths and identities use Carrera documents; width, spacing and R1/R2 road-edge diameters use independent published measurements. Exact mould tolerances are not established.
Crossovers, narrow sections, banking, loops, junctions and digital switches are reference-only; their actual paths and elevation are not replaced by straight/flat geometry.
R3 identity/45-degree angle is published, but its road-edge diameter remains unverified in this pack; no buildable model is supplied.
